2024-25 season: 49 games (19 starts) 8 goals and 7 assists [...] However, since he is still a young player, he has shown many mistakes on big stages even when he has good chances. In particular, in the first and second legs of the Champions League semifinals against Lyon, the movement was good, but 3 or 4 chances that should have been goals were wasted. The team easily defeated Lyon and advanced to the final thanks to the performances of Olic, Robben, and Schweinsteiger. Afterwards, they won the DFB-Pokal final against SV Werder Bremen . Afterwards, he [...] He started as a starter in the Champions League round of 16 second leg against Paris Saint-Germain. He recorded a pass success rate of 86%, 2 opportunity creations, 3/4 successful tackles, 1 block, 1 interception, and 9 ball recoveries, and was very active on both offense and defense.
